title: Ukrainian attacks prompt Russian-held Crimea to halt civilian gasoline sales
summary: Officials in Russia-occupied Crimea suspended civilian gasoline sales Sunday as Ukraine ramped up attacks on fuel supplies on the Black Sea peninsula.
contentText:
Officials in Russia-occupied Crimea suspended civilian gasoline sales Sunday as Ukraine ramped up attacks on fuel supplies on the Black Sea peninsula.

(Image credit: Andriy Andriyenko/Ukrainian 65 Mechanized brigade)
